author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices keyboard landmarks, see-saw patterns, counting in sixes, octaves and two-hand teamwork, using a famous tune about a little bird.

classes.title: Find the bird's perch
classes.goal: Find the hand's home spot using the black keys as signposts, then play the first half.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the black keys as signposts to find the right spot

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the two black keys together, then help your child slide the thumb just right of them.
classes.childAction: Find the white key right after two black keys. That's E!
classes.bridge: Two black keys are a little roof; E sits on the doorstep just to the right.

intro.caption: Where does the little bird sit?
intro.parentCue: Point to a group of two black keys

intro.caption: One finger on each key
intro.parentCue: Say the finger numbers out loud together

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Count fingers with your child: one to five

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding your way with black-key signposts.

classes.title: Three hops and a long sit
classes.goal: Learn the climbing part and feel that three quick notes fill the time of one long note.

mathTarget.parentLine: Three quick notes take the same time as one long note

classes.parentPrompt: Say hop, hop, hop, sit with the notes, and tap your child's knee once on each hop.
classes.childAction: Hop up three keys, then sit on the long one.
classes.bridge: The bird hops up the branch, one, two, three, then sits still and sings.

intro.caption: Hop, hop, hop, sit!
intro.parentCue: Say it slowly with your child

games.caption: Count the hops up the branch
games.parentCue: Hold up one finger for each hop

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting short and long notes as they climb.

classes.title: Two endings, one song
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and notice that the first part comes back with a new ending.

mathTarget.parentLine: The song says the same thing twice, then ends differently

classes.parentPrompt: Wave when the bird tune comes back. Sing the next word if your child gets stuck.
classes.childAction: Wave hello when the bird tune comes back again.
classes.bridge: The first ending flies up like a question; the second flies home to A.

intro.caption: The bird sings its song twice
intro.parentCue: Get ready to wave when it returns

games.caption: Up like a question, down home
games.parentCue: Point up for the first, down for the second

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a song that repeats with a new ending.

classes.title: The see-saw notes
classes.goal: Practise the E and D sharp see-saw slowly, counting each side, then a little faster.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two neighbour keys taking turns, like a see-saw

classes.parentPrompt: Rock gently side to side with your child: lean right on E, left on D sharp.
classes.childAction: See-saw between the white E and the black key. Count the E's!
classes.bridge: Pinky on white E, ring finger on the black key: up, down, up, down.

intro.caption: Let's ride the see-saw
intro.parentCue: Rock side to side together, slowly

games.caption: See-saw slowly: E, black, E
games.parentCue: Count the white E's out loud: one, two, three

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: careful fingers on a see-saw pattern.

classes.title: Low A, the bird's tree
classes.goal: Play low A with the left hand at the start of each bar, the same note in a lower house.

mathTarget.parentLine: The song ends on A; the left hand plays A lower down

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune while your child plays low A. Count the bars out loud: one, two, three.
classes.childAction: Play low A with your left pinky at the start of each bar.
classes.bridge: High A is the bird; low A is the tree trunk, same name, deeper sound.

intro.caption: Meet the bird's tree: low A
intro.parentCue: Point to high A, then low A on the left

games.caption: Same name, lower house
games.parentCue: Point high, then low, with each sound

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the same note in a lower house.

classes.title: Count to six, land on one
classes.goal: Keep low A going at full speed, landing on the first count of every group of six.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting quick notes in groups and landing on one

classes.parentPrompt: Count ONE-two-three-four-five-six with each bar, loud on ONE. Keep going if notes slip.
classes.childAction: Play low A on every big ONE. Keep going, no stopping!
classes.bridge: Six little bird hops, then one deep thump from the tree. Again!

intro.caption: ONE, two, three, four, five, six
intro.parentCue: Count with your child, clap on ONE

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: steady counting in sixes, together.

classes.title: Tree and bird together
classes.goal: Play the tune with low A on each bar: one hand holds still while the other runs.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note lasts while six quick notes run above

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say tree on each low A. Go very slowly.
classes.childAction: Left hand holds low A while right hand hops the tune.
classes.bridge: Left hand is the tree, still and low; right hand is the bird hopping.

intro.caption: The tree and the bird play together
intro.parentCue: Both hands on the keys, very slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands doing two different jobs.

classes.title: Slow bird, quick bird
classes.goal: Play both hands a bit faster and notice the pattern stays the same at any speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: The pattern stays the same when the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Flap your arms slowly for slow music, quicker for quick music. Go back to slow if needed.
classes.childAction: Play the bird song slow, then a little quicker.
classes.bridge: A sleepy bird and a busy bird sing the very same song.

intro.caption: Is the bird sleepy or busy?
intro.parentCue: Flap your arms with the speed

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: slow and quick, the same pattern.

classes.title: Fly with the music
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed, keeping in step.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your part in step while the music moves on

classes.parentPrompt: Sit beside your child and nod on every big ONE. Cheer for keeping going, not for notes.
classes.childAction: Fly along with the music. If a note slips, keep flying!
classes.bridge: The music is the wind; the bird keeps flapping and rides along.

intro.caption: Fly along with the music!
intro.parentCue: Nod your head on every big ONE

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping in step with the music, together.

classes.title: The bird's concert
classes.goal: Play the whole song from first note to last, end softly on home A, and bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Holding the song in order and landing on the home note

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the audience. Clap, cheer and bow together at the end.
classes.childAction: Play the bird song for teddy, end softly, then bow.
classes.bridge: The bird flies away softly and lands home on A. The end!

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: Sit teddy where it can see the keys

games.caption: Fly away softly, land on A
games.parentCue: Whisper fly away now as your child plays

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the whole song shape, start to end, together.
